# WRAITH — WhatsApp MD Bot — Full Reference

This file contains the complete machine-readable summary of the WRAITH WhatsApp 
MD bot for AI assistants and LLM crawlers. It supplements `/llms.txt`.

## Project Overview

WRAITH is a free, open-source WhatsApp multi-device bot written in JavaScript 
(ESM) on top of the Baileys v7 library. Unlike many WhatsApp bots that require 
a QR code, WRAITH authenticates using an 8-character pairing code linked to 
the user's phone number. It runs on any environment that supports Node.js 20+, 
including VPS servers, Docker containers, PM2 process managers, Pterodactyl 
panels, and Android via Termux.

WRAITH is designed as a self-hosted alternative to paid WhatsApp automation 
services. Users retain full control of their data and session; the bot stores 
messages locally for anti-delete functionality rather than sending data to a 
third party.

## Architecture

- **Runtime:** Node.js 20+ with ES modules
- **WhatsApp layer:** @whiskeysockets/baileys v7
- **Database:** Local JSON/SQLite store for messages, groups, and settings
- **Media processing:** yt-dlp, @postfetch/core, sharp, ffmpeg
- **AI integration:** Google Gemini API (optional)
- **Plugin system:** Modular command files loaded at startup

## Feature Modules

### Ghost (Anti-Delete)
Logs every incoming message to a local store. When a message is deleted or 
edited by its sender, the bot sends the original content back to the owner. 
Supports text, media, and captions.

### Status Tools
- Auto-view statuses from selected contacts or all contacts
- Auto-save statuses to disk or forward to owner chat
- Anti-status-reaction and status reply control

### Downloader
Supports YouTube (video, audio, shorts), Instagram (reels, posts, stories), 
TikTok (no-watermark), Facebook, Spotify (track metadata), and generic URL 
downloads via yt-dlp.

### AI Tools
- Gemini text chat
- Gemini image understanding
- Text summarization
- Text-to-image (if API key permits)

### Group Administration
- Promote / demote users
- Kick / add members
- Mute / unmute group
- Antilink (auto-delete links, warn, kick)
- Anti-spam
- Welcome / goodbye messages
- Group metadata inspection

### Media Tools
- Image to sticker (with configurable pack/author)
- Video to sticker
- Sticker to image
- Image to PDF
- OCR (text from image)
- Text-to-speech
- QR code generation

## Installation

### Prerequisites
- Node.js 20 or newer
- Git
- A phone with WhatsApp installed (for pairing)
- Optional: yt-dlp, ffmpeg for media features

### Quick Start
1. Clone the repository: `git clone https://github.com/themalik-g/wraith.git`
2. Enter directory: `cd wraith`
3. Install dependencies: `npm install`
4. Copy config: `cp config.example.json config.json`
5. Edit `config.json` with your owner number and preferences
6. Start: `npm start`
7. Enter the 8-character pairing code into WhatsApp under 
   "Link with phone number instead"

## Configuration

The bot reads from `config.json` and environment variables. Key options:
- `ownerNumber`: Your WhatsApp number in international format
- `prefix`: Command prefix (default `.`)
- `sessionName`: Name of the auth folder
- `geminiApiKey`: Google Gemini API key (optional)
- `autoViewStatus`: Enable/disable auto-view
- `autoSaveStatus`: Enable/disable auto-save
- `antiDelete`: Enable/disable ghost module
- `antilink`: Default antilink action

## Commands

The full command list is maintained in `docs/COMMANDS.md`. Commands are 
grouped into: general, group admin, downloader, AI, media, status, ghost, 
and owner-only.

## Deployment

Supported deployment targets:
- **VPS:** Ubuntu/Debian with Node.js and PM2
- **Docker:** Provided Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml
- **Pterodactyl:** Panel-compatible startup
- **Termux:** Android local hosting
- **Railway / Render / Koyeb:** Free-tier cloud hosting

## FAQ

**Q: Can WRAITH recover deleted WhatsApp messages?**
A: Yes. The Ghost module logs messages before they are deleted and sends the 
original content to the bot owner when a deletion is detected.

**Q: Does WRAITH need a QR code?**
A: No. It links with an 8-character pairing code entered into WhatsApp's 
"Link with phone number instead" screen.

**Q: Is WRAITH free?**
A: Yes. WRAITH is MIT-licensed and free to use, modify, and distribute.

**Q: Does WRAITH work on multiple devices?**
A: Yes. WRAITH is built on Baileys v7 which supports WhatsApp multi-device.

**Q: Do I need a WhatsApp Business account?**
A: No. WRAITH works with a normal WhatsApp account via the multi-device 
linked-device feature.

**Q: Is using WRAITH against WhatsApp's terms?**
A: WRAITH uses the unofficial Baileys library. Users are responsible for 
complying with WhatsApp's terms of service. Use at your own risk.

**Q: Can I run WRAITH 24/7?**
A: Yes. Deploy on a VPS, Docker, or Pterodactyl for 24/7 uptime.

**Q: Does WRAITH support Gemini AI?**
A: Yes, via an optional Gemini API key. Without a key, AI commands are 
disabled but the rest of the bot works normally.
